subject: MAP kickoff: Helix BioSystems evaluation - roles, benchmarks, and prompt governance
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@helixbio.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: Helix BioSystems evaluation - roles, benchmarks, and prompt governance

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for agreeing to run the short evaluation with Redwood. To make the POC effective and timeboxed, I put together a one-page Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a compact benchmark plan that we suggest you use as the canonical success criteria. High level proposal: a focused 4-week eval with two parallel tracks (quality benchmarks + infra/load checks) and a final review that decides next steps (Dedicated trial or production pilot).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or adjust):
- Pass quality: top-1 response accuracy >= 85% on your clinical-FAQ gold set (sample size: 500 prompts)
- Latency: p50 < 150ms and p95 < 500ms for the main API route under target concurrency (30 rps)
- Cost: median token unit cost under projected production baseline (TBD with your token mix)
- Safety: zero high-severity hallucination incidents on 200 safety-focused prompts

Owners we propose from our side (assigning now to keep momentum):
- Prompt set & eval scripts: Lauren Bishop (lauren_bishop@redwood.com)
- Benchmark orchestration & metrics tracking: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com)
- Infra/throughput/traffic profile & Dedicated trial coordination: Jordan Blake (jordan_blake@redwood.com)

Action items for Helix: please confirm the Helix stakeholders and the person who will own prompt approval and data/credential access. We also need a short list (<=200) of priority prompt examples you care most about for week 1 smoke tests.

Attachments: Helix_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx, BenchmarkPlan_Redwood_helix.pdf

Proposed kickoff call: Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 PT — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees.

Thanks and looking forward —

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Emma Torres <emma@helixbio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@helixbio.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@helixbio.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Helix BioSystems evaluation - roles, benchmarks, and prompt governance

Ben —

Appreciate the clear plan and owners. Confirming Helix attendees: myself (program lead), Dr. Sarah Lopez (clinical SME), and Tom Reed (security/compliance). Tom will own the data access approvals.

Quick notes/questions from our side:
- The quality threshold is in the right ballpark. Can we add an additional metric for medical-terminology recall on the 100 specialist prompts (recall >= 90%)?
- For latency: the p95 target looks tight under 30 rps if we include long-context prompts. Can we run the first smoke with 30 rps but capped to 512 tokens? We can iterate after the first run.
- On privacy: Tom wants to confirm that logs can be routed to our S3 and that sensitive prompts are redacted before storage.

We can take the proposed kickoff time on Nov 23 10:00 PT. I’ll forward a short internal doc with our priority prompt list by EOD Monday.

Thanks —

Emma Torres
Head of Product & Data Partnerships
Helix BioSystems
emma@helixbio.com

> Ben —
> 
> Appreciate the clear plan and owners. Confirming Helix attendees: myself (program lead), Dr. Sarah Lopez (clinical SME), and Tom Reed (security/compliance). Tom will own the data access approvals.
> 
> Quick notes/questions from our side:
> - The quality threshold is in the right ballpark. Can we add an additional metric for medical-terminology recall on the 100 specialist prompts (recall >= 90%)?
> - For latency: the p95 target looks tight under 30 rps if we include long-context prompts. Can we run the first smoke with 30 rps but capped to 512 tokens? We can iterate after the first run.
> - On privacy: Tom wants to confirm that logs can be routed to our S3 and that sensitive prompts are redacted before storage.

Thanks Emma — yes to all three. We’ll add the medical-terminology recall metric to the benchmark plan and cap the first smoke to 512 tokens. On logs/redaction: Jordan, can you confirm the flow (and whether Helix needs a short onboarding doc for S3 credentials)?

Internal assignments (confirmed):
- Lauren Bishop: prompt set curation, prompt approval process, and automated eval scripts (deliverable: prompt repo + eval harness by Nov 30)
- Priyom Das: benchmark orchestration & results dashboard (deliverable: initial baseline report by Dec 7)
- Jordan Blake: infra/tallying with Tom for S3 routing and Dedicated trial configuration (blocked until Helix provides access)

I’ve attached the updated MAP draft and the benchmark plan PDF. I’ll create the HubSpot milestone for the Nov 30 prompt freeze and Dec 10 final review (link above).

Proposed meeting note items for the kickoff call:
- Confirm success criteria and add recall metric (Dr. Lopez)
- Agree on prompt ownership & review cadence (Lauren + Helix reviewer)
- Data access and redaction flow (Tom + Jordan)
- Runbook for smoke test and schedule for baseline run (Priyom)

See you on the call in a few minutes.

Best,

Ben
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Thanks all — quick confirmation from my side:
- I’ll own prompt curation and the review tracker. Will post the prompt repo link and a short reviewer guide by Nov 27.
- For the 100 specialist prompts, I’ll add tags for clinical-terminology terms so we can measure recall separately.
- If Helix can share the first batch of 200 priority prompts by end of day Mon (Nov 30 cutoff for Week 1 smoke), we’ll schedule the baseline run the morning of Dec 1.

Happy to sync with Sarah for clinical context if useful — Sarah, could you highlight any edge cases we should lock down early?

- Lauren
